title: Crash on Southbound I-35 Near 4100 Block; Police Blocking Lanes, Expect Delays
excerpt: Laredo police are on the scene of a crash on southbound Interstate 35 near the 4100 block Friday evening, Nov. 13, blocking the inner lane and the left outer shoulder. Drivers should use caution and expect delays.
content:
Laredo police are on the scene of a crash on southbound Interstate 35 near the 4100 block on Friday evening, Nov. 13.

The Laredo Police Department reported the crash at about 6:32 p.m. Officers are blocking off the inner lane and the left outer shoulder while they work the scene.

Drivers heading south on I-35 through the area should use caution and expect delays.

No injuries were reported in the department's post, and no cause for the crash was given. This is a developing story.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 13, 2026.
